content:
- Overestimate prices in the short term after positive sentiment spikes; model tends to overreact to bullish sentiment.
- Underestimate prices after negative sentiment periods; model underweights downward momentum.
- Overshoot upward trends in the 30-day horizon after recent spikes; model fails to cap momentum.
- Underestimate downward corrections after strong upward moves; model misses mean reversion in bearish sentiment.
- Lag in price response to sentiment shifts: model reacts 1–2 days too late to sentiment changes.
- When sentiment is neutral or mildly negative, model tends to forecast higher prices than true outcome; adjust downward by 1–2% for such periods.
- In 30-day forecasts, model consistently overestimates the peak of the trend; cap forecast at 1.5–2 standard deviations above recent 10-day average.
